items.title: zworld_actor_adequacy_locus H-F: OVER-CAPACITY DECODER SWEEP on the banked V3-EXQ-1002/1008 dataset -- is the oracle's decision-relevant content recoverable from the frozen 978-OFF z_world at ANY decoder capacity? Representation held fixed, decoder capacity swept over 5 rungs (fitted-linear -> the consumer's own 32->128 PPO trunk -> 2048-wide -> a 4-layer 2048 over-parameterised decoder, a ~77,000x parameter range) on three 32-dim tracks: the frozen latent (subject), PCA-32 of the encoder's own input (protocol anchor) and the untrained latent (negative control); 16 arms x 3 seeds
items.note: OVER-CAPACITY DECODER SWEEP adjudicating H-F-content-discarded-at-encode, the single leg left live on frozen-ledger question zworld_actor_adequacy_locus. Routed by the CONFIRMED, user-gated failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1008_2026-09-08 section 8 route 1 (REE_assembly 3f86587d6d; Step 8 gate held 2026-09-08T06:18:57Z, all four recommendations accepted). NEW NUMBER, not a 1008 letter: that autopsy's section 7 REFUSES a lettered 1008b re-running the same design at more power, and this is not that -- 1008 held the READER'S CAPACITY FIXED at the consumer's width and varied the INPUT REPRESENTATION; this holds the REPRESENTATION FIXED and varies the DECODER'S CAPACITY, which no run in the 813->948->978->1002->1008 lineage has done (autopsy section 4c). claim_ids DELIBERATELY EMPTY (INV-088/MECH-457 peripheral per the 978 autopsy; MECH-457's re-derive brake stands at 13, INV-088's at 2 -- re-attaching either would increment a brake counter on a run exercising neither mechanism). EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE diagnostic. | DESIGN: 16 arms x 3 seeds = 1 instrument gate + 3 tracks x 5 capacity rungs. Rungs (action-path params MEASURED by --self-test at in_dim 32): linear 165 -> mlp128 21,381 -> mlp512 282,117 -> mlp2048 4,274,181 -> deep2048x4 12,666,885, a ~77,000x range. mlp128 IS x734.PPOPolicyNet at PPO_TRUNK_HIDDEN, i.e. the consumer's own reader (21,381 matches 1008's reported action-path count for every 32-dim arm exactly). Tracks: zworld_off (frozen 978-OFF latent, THE SUBJECT; 1008 at mlp128 = 0.6686 mean, 0/3 clear), ws250_pca (PCA-32 of the encoder's own 250-dim input, THE CALIBRATION ANCHOR certifying the PROTOCOL; 1008 = 0.8684, 3/3 clear), zworld_untrained (warmup skipped, THE NEGATIVE CONTROL attributing an ELIMINATED verdict; 1008 = 0.699/0.681/0.704, ABOVE the trained latent on every seed -- costs no warmup). | VERDICT: per (track,seed) the MAX held-out oracle-action agreement OVER RUNGS (a max, not the top rung: an over-parameterised decoder may overfit and fall). OFF best clears 0.80 bar + 0.20 elevation on >=2/3 seeds -> H-F ELIMINATED, content survives the encode, repair is INTERFACE REFORMATTING (the cheap build); does not clear while both guards hold -> H-F CONFIRMED, content DESTROYED at encode, repair is at the ENCODER'S OBJECTIVE (the expensive build). Those two builds differ by >1 order of magnitude in cost, which is why the autopsy bought one banked-data probe rather than building. | GUARD 1 overcapacity_fit_protocol_sound: anchor(deep2048x4) - anchor(mlp128) >= -0.10, worst seed. NOT best-minus-consumer, which is >=0 by construction and could never fire. | GUARD 2 overcapacity_decoder_can_memorise: OFF TRAIN-split agreement, MAX OVER RUNGS, >= 0.95 worst seed -- a decoder that memorises and still cannot generalise has not failed for want of capacity. Either guard failing, or a red verdict arm, self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue and NEVER a content verdict. | AUTHORING-TIME MEASUREMENT, full dataset scale, seed 42, anchor track (no warmup needed), experiments/_scratch/exq1010_topring_trainability_probe.py: n_train_rows 5038 / n_heldout 2148 (reproduces 1008's 5038/4997/4423). mlp128 final_ce 0.1061 train 0.9653 heldout 0.8836 (1.7s); mlp2048 0.0027 / 1.0000 / 0.8780 (24.7s); deep2048x4 0.0111 / 0.9978 / 0.8641 (66.1s). NONE diverges, the over-capacity rungs DEMONSTRABLY MEMORISE (0.998-1.000 vs the 0.95 floor), Guard 1's delta would be -0.0195 (inside -0.10, and negative -- added capacity mildly overfits, which is what the guard exists to bound), and held-out agreement is FLAT-TO-DECLINING in capacity ON A REPRESENTATION THAT DOES CARRY THE CONTENT (0.8836->0.8780->0.8641), which is why the verdict is an absolute bar plus elevation and never a within-track capacity trend. | GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout is held-out oracle_action_agreement as a function of DECODER CAPACITY on a fixed representation. Absent from every manifest in the lineage by construction -- 1002 and 1008 both PINNED capacity at the consumer's width as a deliberate capacity_match requirement, which the 1008 autopsy names as the lineage's observation bottleneck ('no run in the lineage varies the reader's capacity'). Not recoverable by reanalysis -> run. | 2.5b brake: no claim tagged; a diagnostic discriminator is explicitly permitted, and the autopsy's own R1-R3 re-run records the counters unchanged with this target claim-free so the counter never reaches it. | 2.5c: SD-018 (degrading; stack.py/zworld_p0.py/agent.py) is exercised by the warmup BY DESIGN -- the latent must be 978's, defects included; open corrupting entries on agent.py/config.py (mode-governance-engagement, SD-082) name mechanisms this DV never reads (supervised decode of a FROZEN latent; action selection is never consulted). Same disposition V3-EXQ-1008 landed under, on a strictly smaller exposure. | DV-SYMMETRY per arm: DV is per-state argmax agreement with the oracle's discrete action; its symmetry group is any logit transform preserving per-state argmax (broadcast additive constant, positive monotone rescaling, permutation of interchangeable units). The manipulation is a change of the decoder's FUNCTION CLASS (parameter count and depth) and is invariant under NONE of them: it is not an offset (a larger function class is not a constant), not a monotone rescaling (the ranking itself is what changes), not a permutation (rungs are ordered by capacity and not exchangeable). It reaches the DV through the fitted decoder's held-out argmax. rawfield_ceiling carries no capacity manipulation at all -- it is the instrument gate and is excluded from every capacity comparison and from the verdict. The reader-free witness has no fitted action head in its path, so the logit-symmetry group does not apply to it. | DV_HEADROOM declared: agreement_elevation (ceiling headroom over the strongest trivial predictor, margin 2.0) and agreement_absolute (rawfield ceiling 0.973-0.985 vs the 0.80 bar), both inherited from 1002/1008 unchanged. | FINGERPRINTS: all 48 cells stamped, include_driver_script_in_hash=False with x1002/x1008/x724/x734/x737/x808 folded via extra_substrate_paths; OFF and untrained cells stamped reuse-INELIGIBLE (the frozen agent is shared across that track's five rungs); decoder init re-seeded from the cell seed before every fit, so paired differentials carry no init-draw component. | SMOKE: --self-test 14 grid rows + whole-cube invariants incl. capacity strictly increasing (exit 0); validate_experiments.py --strict OK with 0 warnings across all 37 checks; --dry-run exit 0, all 16 arms exercised incl. the warmup, the witness at every rung and the saturation refit, 16/16 arm fingerprints, correct dry-scale insufficient_seeds self-route, validate_recording --strict OK, z_goal_stream recorded with no writer defect. | red-team (fable): CONTESTED, no BLOCKING, ONE pass (not re-spawned -- no finding changed the causal chain without also being applied). EIGHT findings, each verified at source; SIX APPLIED, TWO DISCLOSED. F1 APPLIED (HIGH: the frozen-latent reproduction band ROUTED NOWHERE -- gate_green read per_arm_gate.non_degenerate, which is ANY-arm-green by design, so the instrument arm alone satisfied it while the band failed and a content verdict still fired; fixed by an explicit verdict_ready = every VERDICT ARM green BY NAME, checked before both guards, with its own load-bearing criterion and two self-test rows). F1b APPLIED (HIGH, same finding: the draft had silently DROPPED x1002's own preconditions -- zworld_encoder_trained_in_p0, zworld_not_collapsed, oracle_labels_non_degenerate, heldout_split_sufficient, d3_local_view_greedy_clears_floor; now PRECONDITION_SPECS = list(x1002.PRECONDITION_SPECS) + NEW, as 1008 does, with measured computed PER ARM so a track's encoder health is certified by its own cells). F2 APPLIED then SETTLED BY MEASUREMENT (HIGH: fixed Adam lr across 77,000x confounds capacity with trainability, citing the smoke's diverging deep rung; grad-clip at 1.0 added IDENTICALLY at every rung so the manipulation stays capacity alone, plus a per-rung diverged flag and Guard 2 as a max-over-rungs -- then the full-scale probe above showed the divergence was purely a DRY-SCALE artifact and every rung fits. The reviewer's per-rung learning rate was NOT adopted: it would vary two things at once to fix a problem that does not exist at the scale this runs at). F3 APPLIED (CONFIRMED was inseparable from 'map present but under-sampled', and the draft's '~7,900 training rows' was wrong -- corrected to 1008's measured 5038/4997/4423, independently reproduced at 5038, and a sample_saturation_witness added: the OFF mlp512 rung refit on 50% of training rows with the held-out delta recorded. RECORDED not gated -- sample size is a different axis from the one the autopsy's routing named). F4 APPLIED (no untrained track, so ELIMINATED could not be attributed to the ENCODE rather than the 250->32 BOTTLENECK -- and 1008 measured the untrained latent ABOVE the trained one on every seed, so this was live, not theoretical; a full third track added at zero warmup cost, plus off_minus_untrained_best per seed and an explicit line in the ELIMINATED branch). F5 APPLIED (the docstring described Guard 1 in the DEGENERATE best-minus-consumer form the code had already rejected). F6 APPLIED (_worst_cell returns (0.0,None) on empty, which would fail Guard 1 OPEN, and the anchor rows carried no cell_id so the offending seed always reported null; cell_id supplied, and the fail-open path DISCLOSED as unreachable because the instrument gate and verdict_ready both precede Guard 1 and both require the very arms whose absence would empty that list). F7 APPLIED (the reader-free witness had no baseline and no collapse guard -- the smoke showed the DIVERGED rung producing the HIGHEST witness agreement, 0.60, with decision-coordinate r2 of -50.9, a near-constant decode laundering the label marginal; added nonlinear_decode_margin_over_trivial, a nonlinear_decode_collapsed flag on negative decision-coord r2, and a run-level collapsed_witness_rungs set). F8 APPLIED (criteria whose statistic is a max over rungs were owned by the top rung, so a diverged top rung would report non_degenerate:false for a verdict that came cleanly off another rung; now owned by the consumer rung). SEPARATELY, validate_experiments caught a false-cache-HIT the red team did not: GRAD_CLIP_NORM and SATURATION_FRACTION are readout-affecting constants that were absent from the declared config_slice of a cross-driver-reusable fingerprint -- both now declared as dict() keywords, which is the spelling the audit can actually resolve. Findings file: scratchpad redteam_1010.md.

items.title: INV-104 / ARC-138 regulatory anchoring vs GOV-MATCHAUX-1 matched arbitrary auxiliary: three P0a objectives (generic-only / matched-arbitrary count-functional prox target / resource-prox target) + SD-070 default, untrained floor, PCA-32 width ceiling, raw-field ceiling; DV = 1002's frozen sense-time z_world oracle-adapter agreement, paired by seed; PASS iff C beats both A and B by >= 0.05 on 2/3 seeds; C0 sensitivity witness routes an insensitive instrument to non_contributory
items.note: red-team (opus): BLOCKING on pass 1 (11 findings: no in-run sensitivity witness so an insensitive instrument routed to 'both weaken'; C3 non-degeneracy inverted; C5 override inside PASS; matched target leaked the oracle ACTION (per-cell wall/empty functional, +5..+17 pts); one-sided R2 floor; matching certified on the calibration draw not the training rollout; trainer-path vs sense-path gate; C4/C6 unread; falsy-zero readbacks; CFULL reproduction ungated) -> all fixed or recorded as witnesses (see driver docstring), re-reviewed once by a fresh opus reviewer: CONTESTED -> (a) the sensitivity witness admitted trained-vs-untrained contrasts so a purely destructive encoder move could pass it: FIXED, C0 now reads only objective-CHOICE contrasts between trained arms (CFULL-A, B-A, C-A, C-B); nan-unsafe elevation readback FIXED; F8 (gate on trainer path, DV on sense path) DISMISSED with reasoning: the gate certifies delivered supervision at the one site the manipulation reaches, sense-path R2 and the arm-invariant relative residual are recorded (seed-42 full-scale: relative residual 0.80); F7 identical-rollout claim verified line by line. FULL-SCALE SEED-42 MEASUREMENT of the otherwise-unmeasured gates (60 P0a eps, 90 calibration eps): B own-target R2 0.61, C own-target R2 0.48 (gap 0.13 vs 0.20), B's head reads prox at R2 0.12 (recorded leak), training-rollout certification KS 0.147, |r| 0.117, oracle-action decodability elevation -0.013 (prox +0.014). | Campaign W6-S6 item 3 (chip-20260904-regulatory-anchoring-matched-aux; science_wave_campaign_plan_20260908b.md section 3 S6). EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE evidence, claim_ids [INV-104, ARC-138] with per-claim directions; GOV-MATCHAUX-1 is the design rule, not tested; never INV-088/MECH-457 (brake fired at 978). ARMS x seeds 42/43/44 (978/1002/1008 lineage seeds): rawfield_ceiling, ws250_pca (PCA-32 of the encoder input), zworld_untrained, zworld_p0_generic (A: SD-070 var/cov/recon only), zworld_p0_matched_arbitrary (B: A + prox head at 0.5 on a matched arbitrary target: fixed linear functional of per-entity COUNTS over the local-view cells for non-resource/non-hazard slots -- cell-permutation-invariant hence direction-blind -- decorrelated from the prox target and quantile-mapped onto its marginal; certified on the P0a TRAINING ROLLOUT: KS<=0.25, |r|<=0.20, oracle-action decodability elevation <=0.04, |R2_C-R2_B|<=0.20; authoring-time measurements KS 0.07-0.18, |r| 0.03-0.18, action elevation -0.03..-0.01), zworld_p0_regulatory_prox (C: A + prox head at 0.5 on the SD-018 resource-proximity target), zworld_p0_sd070_default (CFULL = 1008's zworld_off P0a; reproduction witness 0.672/0.674/0.661). Seam: run_zworld_p0(config=, target_fn=) (experiments/_lib/zworld_p0_warmup.py, backward bit-identical, contract-tested) + experiments/_lib/matched_aux_targets.py. P0b/P1 NOT run: they train no latent_stack parameter and nothing read here depends on e2 or the policy. DV = held-out oracle-action agreement of 1002's capacity-matched adapter on FROZEN sense-time z_world (aux heads never read at inference = GOV-MATCHAUX-1 head removal). CRITERIA (paired, 2/3 majority): C0 SENSITIVITY WITNESS max(|CFULL-A|,|B-A|,|C-A|,|C-B|)>=0.05 (objective-CHOICE contrasts between trained arms only; A-UNT and CFULL-UNT recorded as witnesses) (FALSE -> p0a_objective_invisible_to_adapter_dv, both non_contributory, non_degenerate false -- 1008 measured full-recipe-vs-untrained at -0.026, so this outcome is live and pre-registered), C1 C-B>=0.05, C2 C-A>=0.05 (load-bearing), C3 |C-B|<0.02, C4 B-A>=0.05, C5 R(A)>=0.75 (INV-104 F1), C6 R(A,C,CFULL)<=0.25, C9 CFULL reproduces 1008 within 0.005 (witness); grid: C1&C2 -> PASS regulatory_anchoring_beats_matched_control (both supports); C3 -> matched_control_matches_anchoring (both weakens); C2 only -> generic_auxiliary_supervision_effect (ARC-138 non_contributory, INV-104 mixed); else inconsistent (mixed); C5 forces INV-104 weakens on FAIL branches only. DV HEADROOM declared and measured in-run: achievable = mean(PCA-UNT) (~0.17 per 1008) vs DELTA_MIN 0.05 at margin 2.0. DV-SYMMETRY per arm: the manipulation is the encoder's training objective, the DV is a per-arm RE-FITTED adapter's argmax agreement -- not invariant under any broadcast, monotone or permutation symmetry (the adapter and standardiser are refit per arm, and the untrained/PCA anchors bracket the range). GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = paired agreement between P0a-objective arms; no recorded manifest carries a generic-only or matched-arbitrary P0a arm (the seam did not exist before 2026-09-09); reanalysis_query scanned 0 manifests on this box (tool path issue) -- UNT/PCA/RAW/CFULL re-run for pairing, minutes each. Step 2.5c: open corrupting entries (MECH-320 tonic_vigor, mode-governance-engagement, SD-082 lateral_pfc, contextmemory write, blocked_agency) list agent.py/config.py module-level but their defective paths are selection-time; this driver never calls select_action (sense() + latent_stack training only). DEGRADING overlaps noted: SD-018 (stack.py, zworld_p0.py -- the prox head IS the manipulation channel; its amend is pending validation), SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING (config.py, env), mech357 (env). Re-derive brake: 0 autopsies on INV-104, 0 on ARC-138. REGISTRY: new qid regulatory_anchoring_matched_aux + 4 hids named in the manifest; pre-registration in hypothesis_space_registry.v1.json OWED (file owned by fa-20260909-batch at queue time; hypothesis_qid_status recorded) -- the adjudicating autopsy registers it at Step 9b. EXP-1397 (EVB-1712, blocked_substrate on this very seam) shares arms A1/A4 with this run; its status update is owed to governance (experiment_proposals.v1.json claimed by igw-233-inv104-reanalysis at queue time). Ethics preflight all false / allow.

items.title: MECH-027 hypervigilance signature: elevated precision + shortened horizon + suppressed offline replay, forced and reverted within-run on ONE trained agent per seed (supersedes V3-EXQ-981; 2026-09-09 repair of the 2026-09-04 blocked draft)
items.note: TWO-STAGE: Stage A = warmup(200 ep x 120 steps) + commit-threshold calibration + EVAL_BASELINE (25 ep) per seed, then Gate A (positive control on avoidance LIFT HIGH-vs-SAFE; per-seed coverage floor 30; pooled positive-control-band floor 150; baseline offline replay engaged via sws_n_writes>=1 on every firing; C1 and precision-margin dv_headroom, mean-matched); Stage B = EVAL_HYPERVIGILANT + EVAL_REVERSION only if Gate A met. C1 (load-bearing): pooled AMBIGUOUS-band avoidant RATE elevation HV-BASELINE >= 0.10 absolute on a [0,1] DV; C2: >= 50% of that elevation reverts. Channel (c) 'suppressed replay' is the SD-017 offline passes (config.sws_enabled/rem_enabled per block, draws_per_cycle 0 in HV) -- NOT the mech285 draw count, whose only consumer is sign-inverted for suppression and whose pool is intermittently empty (driver docstring B1/B2, both verified at source 2026-09-09; Step 2.5a probe: SWS write moves E1.ContextMemory/read/generate_prior, disabled pass moves nothing, revertible). GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (AMBIGUOUS-band availability-normalised avoidance rate under forced precision/short-horizon/suppressed-offline-replay) recorded in no manifest -- V3-EXQ-981 (the only MECH-027 run) used the single-argmax DV, old band cutpoints, an empty anchor pool and an uncalibrated commit threshold; not recoverable, run required. DV-symmetry: per-tick binary membership DV, manipulation is a discrete selection-level change of membership (not a broadcast constant, not a relabelling) -- driver docstring. Gated on nothing: node is complex (probe-gated) -> this run converts it. Dry-run: exit 0, Stage B exercised as forced code-path positive control (gate_a_forced_for_smoke stamped). red-team (fable, 2026-09-09): CONTESTED -- 6 findings, none BLOCKING, ALL SIX FIXED (none dismissed): F1 C1/C2 now read the AMBIGUOUS-band availability-normalised LIFT (within-band chance shifted 0.329->0.378 BASE->HV in the smoke, half the bar); F2 Gate B floors the pooled AMBIGUOUS n in HV/REVERSION/HV_AB (150 scaled) and per-block E3 selections (30 scaled), unscorable_in_safe recorded; F3 per-episode AMBIGUOUS lift series per block, |BASELINE half-drift|>=0.05 routes the C1-and-not-C2 cell to non_contributory; F4 NEW PAIRED BLOCK EVAL_HV_AB_PAIRED on a deep copy of the post-Stage-A agent+env from the same RNG state ((a)+(b) forced, offline passes ON) so lift(HV)-lift(HV_AB) is the paired contribution of suppressing replay; PASS with |contrast|<0.02 routes to 'mixed' (channels a+b only, c inert); F5 BASELINE non-argmin fraction of precision-scaled graded picks recorded, weakens null under <0.10 routes to non_contributory (channel (a) range-limited), engagement gate per block; F6 positive control on pooled counts (the statistic the 150 floor was derived for). Smoke after fixes: exit 0, Stage B + paired block exercised, validate_experiments --strict 0 warnings, validate_recording complete. Four eval blocks now (25 ep each): est 220 min (981 measured 165 for three). Step 2.5c: open corrupting entries mode-governance-engagement and SD-082 overlap only via ree_core/agent.py; both default-off flags unset here (grep 0). Re-derive brake MECH-027: 1 counted autopsy (981) < 2. Design node: complex (probe-gated) -> this run.
